_: よみもの島 (Book Island). One big library — walk in and your bookshelf opens. The books (text, scenes, glossary and the quiz ANSWERS) are not here: they live in server/src/game/reading-bank/ and the room sends a book without its answers. Coordinates are relative to the island's own x/z. Colours are decimals because island-kit.js reads them as numbers.
